You draw a breath that burns pleasantly in your chest, then open your mouth and breathe a stream of fire across the ground ahead.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Fortitude
Target / range / shape
Every other creature in three contiguous squares in a straight line from you.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Attack

Breathe fire. Make one roll using the net Boons or Banes least favorable to you among the targets; include allies in the line.

Weak
3 fire damage.
Standard
3 fire damage and Burning 1.
Strong
5 fire damage and Burning 1.
